purpose: Local evaluation fixtures for proposed person tracking and passage counting; not model training.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 as stated by MOTChallenge; original sequence conditions may additionally apply
license.attribution: MOTChallenge and the original sequence creators listed on the dataset pages. PETS09: Ferryman et al. 2009; TUD: Andriluka et al. 2008/2010; MOT17: MOTChallenge benchmark authors and sequence sources.

conditions: camera-motion negative control for fixed-line counts

selection_rules: The raw sequence video is model input. Ground-truth overlay videos must never be model input.
DPM, FRCNN and SDP variants of one MOT17 sequence share footage; only SDP is selected.
MOT15 Venice-2 and ADL-Rundle-6 overlap MOT17 sequences; they are not separate evaluation fixtures here.
Calibration and holdout are separated by source sequence. Cropped or degraded copies retain their parent's split.
Benchmark IDs are sequence-local and do not establish identity across days or different sequences.
These datasets supply boxes and tracking identities, not clothing labels, calendar capture dates or ground-truth passage events for our chosen line.
